fluff.overview:
Taurian infantry reflect the Concordat's citizen-soldier tradition, with national service requirements ensuring that most adults have received basic military training before ever donning a uniform. Motorized platoons provide faster response than foot infantry without the cost of full mechanized transport, riding light vehicles or motorcycles that can cover ground quickly on the road networks connecting Taurian population centers. Their speed makes them well-suited to the wide-area patrol duties that Concordat garrison doctrine demands.

Equipped with laser rifles that offer superior range and armor penetration compared to ballistic weapons, these platoons field one of the most effective personal arms available to conventional infantry, though the weapons are significantly more expensive and require soldiers to carry additional power packs.
